svg.text: GMRS REPEATER INTERFACE — REV 3 ACCURATE SCHEMATIC
LM2904P buffered isolated audio path + ESP32 PTT and RX detect
CRITICAL: RX_RED / RX radio ground is isolated from CIRCUIT_GND / TX copper ground by transformer T1.
Do not solder RX_RED directly to TX copper/CIRCUIT_GND unless you intentionally bypass isolation.
unused op-amp B: pin 6 → pin 7; pin 5 → VREF
• Only intentional LM2904 pin-to-pin shorts: pin 1→2 and pin 6→7.
• Pin 3 is the LM2904 audio input; C2 feeds pin 3, not pin 1/2.
• Pin 5 goes to VREF. Pin 4 goes to CIRCUIT_GND. Pin 8 goes to +3.3V.
• RX_RED is isolated and must not connect directly to CIRCUIT_GND / TX copper.
• Set VR2 nearly all the way down before first transmit test.
• Check transistor pinout with datasheet/meter before soldering.
• LM2904 pin 3 ≈ 1.65 V with no audio.
• LM2904 pin 1 ≈ 1.65 V with no audio.
• TX_BLUE should not be grounded until GPIO22 drives Q1.
• RX_RED should show open/no continuity to TX copper/CIRCUIT_GND.
